caption: The drawing depicts a decorative wooden chair backrest, rendered in a realistic manner with visible wood grain and intricate painted designs. The central panel of the backrest is a dark brown, almost black, with a marquetry inlay in shades of reddish-brown, tan, and golden-yellow. The top rail of the backrest is curved and features a complex floral and fruit motif in muted reds, greens, and gold tones. The side supports are slender, extending down and curving slightly outward, with lighter patches suggesting wood texture and shading. The central splat is vase-shaped and adorned with symmetrical patterns, including a stylized urn with foliage and two bird figures facing each other, all executed in the same color palette as the top rail. The background of the drawing is a plain off-white, providing contrast to the richly ornamented and detailed woodwork. The drawing does not show the complete chair, focusing instead on the upper and central portion of the backrest.
title: Boston Rocker
